explanation: For a many-to-many relationship, the linking table stores the foreign keys for both entities. That table records each specific enrollment between one student and one course.

options.text: In an enrollment table that links the student and course tables
Only in the student table, because students are the main entity
Only in the course table, because courses are the main entity
In both the student and course tables as repeating groups

prompt: A university tracks which students enroll in which courses. A student can take many courses, and a course can have many students. In the relational design, where should the student_id and course_id values be stored?

source.section: Creating a relational database with an m:m relationship
source.title: The Many-to-Many Relationship
